records.name: Scene-N-Action Productions
records.summary: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit that offers classes and programs. Registration for fall 2026 is open, and the site does not say what the classes cover.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for a class through the Classes/Register page. The site does not list class topics on that page; the Programs page is the place to check what is offered.

schedule.text: Fall 2026 class registration is open; the page does not list class days or times

first_step.how: Open the Classes/Register page on snapcompany.org to sign up, or call (267) 420-2810 with questions.

records.notes: Legal name: Scene-N-Action Productions Company Inc. The site says fall 2026 registration is open, with no exact date, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The category and interest are chosen from the name only; the site does not name the art form, so check before showing. Address not published: the IRS record address (7942 Germantown Ave, 19118) is not shown on the site. The Facebook page is named on the site but no URL could be verified, so it is left out. The /classes URL returned 404.

records.name: Sisters 4 Harmony
records.notes: Tried. Three fetch attempts (http, https, https with www) got no response, so the site could not be read and nothing about activities, schedule or contacts is recorded. Held back by design until the site can be read or another public source is found. Not a rate limit; the failure was specific to this domain.

records.name: Society to Preserve Philadelphia African American Assets
records.notes: Tried. The typed website (www.sppaaa.org) now shows an unrelated online casino page on every attempt, not the group's own site. The URL is deliberately left out of the record so no link leads visitors to gambling content. Nothing about the group's activities is recorded. Held back by design until a reliable public page is found. Suggest a manual check of the group's current web presence. IRS address (6353 Germantown Ave, 19144) not confirmed publicly.

records.name: Tennessee Program
records.summary: A registered nonprofit that works with young people on skills, school enrichment, character and mentoring. Programs include auto technician training, photography, fitness, a lifestyle course, and a music and engineering program.
records.what_you_do: Join one of the youth programs, or help with community service days such as neighborhood cleanups and gardening.

first_step.how: Use the Volunteer link on tennesseeprogram.com (it opens the contact page) to ask how to join a program or help on a service day. The site does not publish enrollment rules.

records.notes: No dated events, news or posts were found; the Blog/Events link points to a placeholder page. Status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dates. No email or phone is shown; the contact link is /contact-1. Enrollment rules and age limits are not published, so open_to public is a placeholder: check before a visitor relies on it. Crowd is taken from the site's wording about young people and inner-city youth.

records.name: Concord School House and Upper Burying Ground
records.summary: Looks after the Upper Burying Ground, a cemetery started in 1693 in Germantown, and the Concord School House, a schoolroom built in 1775 on the cemetery's corner. Visitors can see both during public hours and at summer evening events.
records.what_you_do: Visit the burying ground and the schoolroom during public hours, or come to an event such as the evening Firefly Hours. The site does not list volunteer or membership options.

schedule.text: Public visit hours, plus Evening Firefly Hours on August 4 to 6, 2026, 5 to 7 pm

first_step.how: Plan a visit during the public hours listed on concordschoolhouse.org, or come to an evening event such as the Firefly Hours in August.
first_step.basis: Public visit hours and events are posted, with no membership step.

records.notes: Legal name: The Concord School House and Upper Burying Ground of Germantown. The site shows public visit hours, an OnePass extension of visit hours from June to September 2026, and the August 2026 Firefly Hours. No membership or volunteer rules are shown.

records.name: Experimental Farm Network
records.notes: Tried. Three attempts (http, https, https with www) failed with a TLS handshake error, so the website could not be read. Nothing about activities, schedule or contacts is recorded. Held back by design until the site can be read. Legal name: The Experimental Farm Network Cooperative. IRS record address (5447 Morris St, 19144) not confirmed publicly.

records.name: Institute for the Preservation of African-American Music
records.notes: Tried. www.itaam.org does not resolve (DNS lookup fails), which matches the liveness check already in the batch (dead, checked 2026-10-08). The bare itaam.org loads a page titled as an Arabic-language food platform, which is not this group. Nothing about current activity is recorded. Held back by design. Not marked defunct: no evidence of dissolution was found, only that the website is unreachable. IRS record address (517 Wadsworth Ave, 19119) not confirmed publicly.

records.name: Water Tower Advisory Council
records.summary: A nonprofit that guides how the Water Tower Recreation Center is developed and used.
records.what_you_do: The site does not describe a way to join or help. The contact page is the only listed step.

first_step.how: Use the contact page at wtrec.org/contact to ask how to take part in the council or its programs.

records.notes: Held back: the site does not say who can attend or join, so audience.open_to is left out. The calendar page lists no events and has a future updates link with no content. The only dates on the front page are a note that the website was created in July 2020 and a copyright footer, neither of which is evidence of activity. Status is probably_active from a working site with no dated items. No email or phone is shown.

records.name: Way Moore Justice Support
records.summary: Supports people who say they were wrongly convicted, their families and their legal teams as they go through Pennsylvania's post-conviction process. Also runs talks, courses and workshops on wrongful convictions and restorative justice.
records.what_you_do: Attend a public talk, film discussion or course the group takes part in, such as the Mt. Airy Learning Tree course listed for winter and spring 2026.

first_step.how: Check the Community Engagement page on waymoorejustice.org for the next public talk or course. The site gives no sign-up steps or contact details, so this is the only listed way in.
first_step.basis: Events are listed publicly, but the site gives no sign-up steps, and at least one talk was for members and guests.

records.notes: Dated items on the community page: August 2026 (Chestnut Hill Rotary Club talk, the August 12th meeting), January 2026 items, and a winter and spring 2026 course at Mt. Airy Learning Tree. The Rotary event was for members and guests, so public may not hold for every event; attendance rules are not published. No email, phone or social links are shown. The IRS record lists a P.O. box, which is not a meeting place, so no location is published.

records.name: Woodford Tennis Club
records.summary: A members-only tennis club founded in 1958 on East Wister Street, with more than 170 active members. Members play on the club's courts, take lessons and clinics, enter tournaments, and join social events.
records.what_you_do: Members play on three clay courts and two hard courts, take lessons or clinics, and join tournaments and social events. The club also runs a youth summer camp and fundraisers.

schedule.text: Club events are posted on the site, for example a chicken or fish fry fundraiser on Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 3 to 8 pm at Lou & Choo's, 2101 Hunting Park Ave.

first_step.how: Click Join Now on woodfordtennisclub.net to join the mailing list for clinics and events. For tournament and fundraiser questions, use the email address on the site.
first_step.basis: Play is for members only, and the site does not say how to apply; the only listed step is a mailing list sign-up.

records.notes: Found by one search, then read on the club's own site. The batch website field held an email address, so it was treated as missing. The search directory gave 4995 Rubicam St, which conflicts with the club's own address (424 E Wister St); the club's own address is used. The site calls the club historically Black; that is the club's own description, not an eligibility rule, so no community tag is set. Clinics for all skill levels are listed, but the site does not say whether non-members can join them. The site also mentions a postponed members tournament for October 9 to 11, 2026; not published. The site is also reachable at woodfordtennisclub.com, which frames the .net site. Lou & Choo's is the fundraiser venue, not a group.

records.name: Yoga 4 Philly
records.summary: The Philadelphia chapter of Yoga 4 the World, a nonprofit that teaches yoga and meditation. The national group's classes are beginner-friendly and trauma-informed, with sliding-scale programs.
records.what_you_do: Take one of the community classes listed under Events, or ask about volunteering through the Contact Us page on the national site.

cost.text: Sliding scale for some programs; check each class listing for the price

first_step.how: Find the Y4P Community Classes listed under Events on yoga4theworld.org and try one. For details, use the Contact Us page.
first_step.basis: Beginner-friendly classes are listed publicly, though the site does not say how to sign up.

records.notes: Legal name: Yoga 4 the World. The batch website yoga4philly.org redirects to yoga4theworld.org, so the redirect target is recorded as the website. The site lists a Philadelphia chapter and community classes under Events, with no dates. Status is probably_active from a working site with no dated items; the Page updated label has no date. No email or phone is shown. Named but not checked, no URL captured: Philadelphia Yoga Teachers.

records.name: Youth Design Philly
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that teaches students the basics of interior design and provides furniture and room design at no cost to students in need.
records.what_you_do: Learn about interior design through the group's education work, or ask about design help for a student in need. The site does not describe volunteer roles.

first_step.how: Use the Contact Us link on youthdesignphilly.org to ask about design help for a student or about the group's education work.

records.notes: Interest tag tutoring is the closest fit for teaching design principles; no exact tag exists. The only date on the site is a copyright footer, which is not evidence, so status is probably_active from a working site with no dated items. Donations go through Cash App and Venmo handles; those are not recorded as contacts. No email or phone is shown. The site does not say how to apply for design services.

records.name: A New Dawn
records.summary: A Mill Creek-Parkside nonprofit that turns vacant lots into gardens, greenhouses and gathering places. It grows food through farming and hydroponics and runs wellness and hands-on STEAM skill building for youth, families and seniors.
records.what_you_do: Ask about the garden plots (see Plot Information on the site), or join a listed session such as the Saturday noon session at Tiffany Fletcher Recreation Center. The events page does not name session topics.

schedule.text: Several recurring sessions are listed, including Saturdays noon to 2 pm from October 3 to November 21 (no year shown on the page)

first_step.how: Pick a listed session on the events page and go to that center. The page does not say whether you need to register, so check the group's site before you go.

records.notes: The events page lists dated sessions with no year, so they are not counted as dated evidence; status is probably_active. Dates on the homepage are image file names, not dates. No email, phone or social links are shown. The IRS record address (4825 Olive St, 19139) is not shown on the site and is not published.

records.name: Black Rebel Nomads
records.summary: A nonprofit that sends young Black artists abroad for cultural exchange trips. Each traveler makes an art project about the experience.
records.what_you_do: Apply through the Apply Now form on the site if you are a Black creative who can travel abroad for about a month in June and July, and are ready to propose an art project about the trip. The site lists one trip, to Bali.

first_step.how: Read the FAQ on blackrebelnomads.org, then apply through the Apply Now form if a trip is open. The newest trip listed is June 2024, so confirm one is running first.
first_step.basis: Applicants need to qualify and apply through a form, and the group may no longer be running trips.

records.notes: Dated items on the site: June 2024 (trip for one youth artist) and September 2023 (501(c)(3) status). The newest is more than 24 months old, so status is dormant. The Instagram handle @BlackRebelNomads is shown on the site, but its link is a placeholder, so no social URL is recorded. No email or phone is shown. The site does not say Philadelphia; the Philadelphia link is only the IRS record address (4813 Parrish St, 19139), so confirm the group serves Philadelphia before showing it locally. Trips are abroad, so no location is published.

records.name: Crystal Bird Fauset Institute for Civic Engagement
records.notes: Hidden because no public way in was found, not because it was confirmed to be a private foundation. The only sign of life is a February 16, 2022 news report (6abc) that the institute is renovating the former home of Crystal Bird Fauset on Vine Street, which the report places in the 5400 block (the batch address is 5403 Vine St), and hopes to open it to the public. No program, sign-up or current website was found, and the executive director named in the article matches the batch contact name. The batch website field held a person's name, so it was treated as missing. One search was used. Revisit if a public program or website appears.

Three fetch attempts failed with a TLS handshake error.
DNS lookup fails. The bare itaam.org shows an unrelated Arabic-language platform page.
Every attempt returned an unrelated online casino page, not the group's site.

notes: Batch of 15 groups: 14 publish, 1 hide. Searches: 2 of 2, both for the two groups with no usable website (Woodford Tennis Club and Crystal Bird Fauset). Fetches: 29 of 60. Four sites could not be read or showed unrelated content (see blocked). Their records are minimal and will be held back by design, because no summary, category, audience or source could be established from the group's own site. Redirects and checks: yoga4philly.org redirects to yoga4theworld.org and that target is recorded; Woodford's .com domain frames its .net site. Named but not checked, with no URL captured: Rotary Club of Chestnut Hill, Mt. Airy Learning Tree, and Philadelphia Yoga Teachers. Batch website fields that were not web addresses: Woodford (an email) and Crystal Bird Fauset (a person's name). IRS addresses are not published unless the group's own site showed them. Footers, copyright lines and image file names were not treated as dates. Did not finish early on any group; no budget was left unused on a lead with a working website.
